mission.title: The Return
mission.description: Recover the stolen device component from the Merovingian operative Binhex.

npc.say: All security precautions have been engaged.
Give the component to Agent Stewart.

phase.briefing: We are in need of your particular... talents, {player}. The second component for our device was in the possession of another operative, until a female human in the employ of the Merovingian led a raid against us. The component was stolen, and is now in her possession. Fortunately, we were prepared for just such a contingency. A tracking device is hidden inside the component. I am sending you the location of the Merovingian operative, Binhex.

enter.say: Okay, keep an eye open for Binhex. The surveillance tapes of her raid look pretty damn impressive.

talk.say: So, you heard what the deal is, right?
You just made a big mistake, {player}.

done.say: Hey, there's a wall safe in this room. It might have what you're after.
A handle, huh? Well, that's what we're looking for.

phase.briefing: One day the Merovingian and his kind shall be deleted. They are a taint upon the pure, clean code of the Matrix. I have sent you the address of one of our representatives. Take the component to her.

done.say: Damn it! The Merovingian's people have been here. I think you should get out of there. Now.

phase.briefing: We did not anticipate this level of... interest in the device. I am sending you the coordinates of a high security location.

enter.say: Okay, you'll be looking for Agent Stewart in here.

objective.text: Give the component to Agent Stewart

done.say: I don't know about you, but I feel a little more comfortable with that component in someone else's hands. Talk about a hot potato.

mission.finish: Rest assured, {player}, that our reprisal against the Merovingian will be devastating.
